_comments.AzureWebJobsStorage: Required for Functions runtime (empty for local dev with Cosmos Emulator)
_comments.PROVIDER_NAME: Telemetry provider - N2KToSignalK for maritime data
_comments.DB_PASSWORD: Database password - set for local testing only
_comments.IoTHubConnectionString: Azure IoT Hub connection string. Get from: Azure Portal > IoT Hub > Shared access policies > service > Connection string. Format: HostName=<hub>.azure-devices.net;SharedAccessKeyName=service;SharedAccessKey=<key>
